falsification_logic.caveat: A final falsification needs measured grain-size labels; v3 reports falsification_pressure for the public subset.
falsification_logic.confirm_like: Boundary/grain-classified samples show low-T κ exponents clustering near 1/2 and fixed T^0.5 wins against T^1/T^2/T^3 baselines.
falsification_logic.falsify_like: Boundary/grain-classified samples do not show any T^1/2-like envelope.
